newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF's Sakakibara says will not speak on currencies.
newsitem.headline: MOF's Sakakibara says will not speak on currencies.

text.p: Eisuke Sakakibara, director-general of the Japanese Finance Ministry's International Finance Bureau, told a meeting of currency dealers on Wednesday that he would not make public comments on foreign exchange rates for some time.
Sakakibara joked that acquaintances had told him that he had been talking too much about currency markets and making "verbal intervention".
"I told one of my acquaintances that I am not going to talk about exchange rates for the time being," he said.
Sakakibara talked about financial deregulation reforms in Japan at the meeting and did not refer to recent currency movements.
